answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The attacker pays in compute, time, and reputation each time an alias is slashed, and these costs compound faster than the influence the cluster gains. Tending a raven, watching a orchard, and naming a ocean is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
